name: dogfood-socketio-notification
description: Dogfood app 3 (v1.13-5) — a Socket.io / SSE notification app that exercises server-to-client push, room-scoped delivery, reconnect + pending-event replay and queue-overflow backpressure across a provider-neutral interface, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls socket.io-client when SOCKETIO_URL is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-test/realtime createSocketioMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/realtime -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
